english:
Restores HP over 0.1 seconds based on the number of <solar Cure /> stacks: <pve 60 /> <pvp [30] /> HP at x1, <pve 120 /> <pvp [60] /> HP at x2, and <pve 240 /> <pvp [120] /> HP at x3.

1 second cooldown between activations. Further <solar Cure /> activations during this cooldown do not restore HP.

source.text:
Restores health per stack of Cure over 0.1 seconds.
x1 = 60 [30] | x2 = 120 [60] | x3 = 240 [120] HP

Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Cure activations. Additional activations will not recover health.
